summary: Compensation enhancement in motor accident claim; disability reassessment from 20% to 100%; monthly income revised from Rs.7,500 to Rs.10,000; reliance on oral evidence for income determination; multiplier method applied with 40% future prospects and 17-year multiplier; medical, attendant, diet, pain and suffering, loss of amenities, and income during treatment awarded; total compensation increased to Rs.37,51,000; interest to continue as per tribunal.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi (2017) 16 SCC 680
Sidram v. Divisional Manager, United India Insurance Ltd. (2023) 3 SCC 439
K.S. Muralidhar v. R. Subbulakshmi & Anr. 2024 SCC Online SC 3385
Raj Kumar v. Ajay Kumar (2011) 1 SCC 343
final_judgment: Civil appeal allowed; compensation enhanced to Rs.37,51,000; impugned order modified; interest as per tribunal order
